source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
North = up on the plan sheets (no printed north arrow seen); world y grows north from the south outer face.

Internal door leaf heights are not drawn on any plan; 2100 mm assumed for all interior doors (F1 and F2). The two entrance doors and all 15 exterior windows have observed heights: window sill/head applied from confirmed dimension-chain claims claim_0001-claim_0006, and entrance door heads z=[0,2.098] applied from claims claim_0009 (South_view.png frame) and claim_0010 (West_view.png frame).

Interior partitions declared on the midplane of their drawn line pairs (drawn ~120 mm thick); corridor walls placed at drawn centre lines y=5000/3000 although the west chain annotates the corridor zone as 250+1500+250.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
Second floor occupies z 3000-6600 per the elevation storey chains (3000 + 3600).
Interior partitions declared on the midplane of their drawn line pairs.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

unresolved: West elevation draws the west entrance door 1200 wide at 3400-4600 while the 1F plan chain gives 1500 at 3250-4750; the plan chain was adopted and the discrepancy is recorded.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

2F divider between bottom rooms C and D read at pixels about 1455-1473 (centre 1466); its drawn line pair partially merges with the adjacent door jamb ink, so its position carries about 110 mm uncertainty. The compiled draft shows no drawing_differences there.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound direct original returns from view_image or paired elevation views are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: Chain 1000+1600+400 measured on both north and south elevations gives z=[1.0,2.6] for all five 1F standard windows; matches declared z.

claims.reason: Ground-floor standard windows. North_view.png left vertical chain reads bottom-up 1000 (sill above z=0) + 1600 (window) + 400 (to 1F top z=3.0); South_view.png shows the same 1000/1600/400 pattern on both side chains for the regular south windows. Segment 1 (the 1600 window run) from origin z=0 gives absolute z=[1.0,2.6]. This matches the z already declared for these windows in the plans.

decision.reason: South chain 1500+600+900 gives z=[1.5,2.1] for the small south window; matches declared z.

claims.reason: Small south window beside the south entrance. South_view.png left chain reads bottom-up 1500 (sill above z=0) + 600 (window) + 900 (to 1F top z=3.0); segment 1 (the 600 window run) gives absolute z=[1.5,2.1]. Matches the declared z of F1:W_S1.

decision.reason: East chain 1000+1800+200 gives z=[1.0,2.8] for the 1F corridor-end window; matches declared z.

claims.reason: Ground-floor corridor-end window on the east facade. East_view.png left chain reads bottom-up 1000 (sill) + 1800 (window) + 200 (to 1F top z=3.0); segment 1 gives absolute z=[1.0,2.8]. Matches the declared z of F1:W_E_corridor.

decision.reason: North 2F chain 1000+1800+800 above z=3.0 gives z=[4.0,5.8]; matches declared z of both 2F north windows.

Segment 1 from origin z=3.0 gives absolute z=[4.0,5.8]. Matches the declared z of the 2F north windows.

decision.reason: South 2F chain 1000+1800+800 above z=3.0 gives z=[4.0,5.8]; matches declared z of all four 2F south windows.

claims.reason: Second-floor south office windows. South_view.png upper chain reads 1000 (sill above 2F floor z=3.0) + 1800 (window) + 800 (to roof z=6.6), total storey 3600. Segment 1 from origin z=3.0 gives absolute z=[4.0,5.8]. Matches the declared z of the 2F south windows.
